contextNote: Refactors the writing plugin's wordlist into separate files by tier and adds a Porter stemmer plus expanded trope-detection patterns, with conversational-vs-document scoping for matches.
Audits the user sandbox config and removes excludedCommands entries that actually run fine sandboxed, keeping only the ones empirically confirmed to need the bypass.

Hardens the experimental honeycomb mcp OAuth flow: scopes the loopback redirect to GET /callback so browser probes no longer corrupt the result channel, makes a corrupt token entry re-authorize instead of dead-ending, narrows the unauthorized/forbidden error detection to avoid misfiring on stray 401/403 digits, persists the DCR client id across invocations, and adds logout tests.
Makes the CLI's -F flag parse JSON object and array values for fields instead of treating everything as a string, and documents why -F rather than -f.
Lets a tmux pane resume its own session on tmux-resurrect restore via a pane-scoped @resume-command option and a post-save-all hook that rewrites the saved restore command, kept program-agnostic.
Extends the catppuccin theme to bat, btop, fzf, lazygit, and yazi by adding a new theme/ dotfiles topic that applies the active flavor per tool.
Switches wt's shell completion registration from clap's static generate() to the dynamic clap_complete::env path so a plain package install (Homebrew) completes branch and worktree names at TAB time.
Modernizes the codebase to current ECMAScript idioms (Object.groupBy, toSorted, at(-1)) and swaps the TypeScript module resolver from node10 to bundler.

Fixes a concurrency bug where XML validity was gated on a process-global parse-error flag, so one thread's malformed parse could mislabel another thread's valid document as invalid; validity now comes from each thread's own parse result.
Refactors formatter dispatch in tflint into per-format adapter types instead of a switch, so each output format owns its rendering.
Adds a colocated eval directory structure for the route-agent project so evals live alongside the code they exercise.
Modernizes the library for a v2 release: converts to TypeScript, upgrades to modern Azure/AWS SDKs, and exposes a promise-based API.
Adds a Worktrees section to the user-level CLAUDE.md directing worktree creation to the wt-switch-create skill and other worktree operations to the generic worktrunk skill.
Broadens the claude-code:session skill description to route hand-rolled transcript access (jq/grep over .jsonl files) into the skill, trimming the example list and adding an explicit trigger.
Adds a wts shell alias for wt switch and a wtp function that prunes clean worktrees then force-removes worktrees whose GitHub PRs are already merged.
Adds an inline PreToolUse hook to the mac:jxa-run skill that disables the sandbox when jxa.ts runs, since osascript inherited sandbox restrictions and failed with -600 errors.

Corrects repo documentation that wrongly claimed disable-model-invocation does not affect skill auto-discovery; the flag actually removes a skill's name and description from always-on context, and contrasts it with user-invocable: false.

Replaces the markless markdown viewer in the terminal dotfiles topic with glow for reading and leaf for live editing, since markless rendered images and diagrams poorly and glow lacks a file-watch mode.
